newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firmer, specifics leave market opaque.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firmer, specifics leave market opaque.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were firmer on Thursday in line with sharp gains on crude and products futures.
But though buying interest was still quite strong, it was mainly limited to specific quality or delivery point/timing leaving bids bids for similar product varying widely.

Few traders were willing to make a market with physical supplies looking fairly tight. The only cargo with a firm offer was the 60kt Algerian piece that has been on offer all week at cif high +$3. Firm buying for LVN barrels was pegged around the same level and a specific requirement for pipeline spec was bid up to around $224 a tonne cif NWE.
